tasks.short: Set and monitor agricultural production targets.

steps.what: Set actual production targets with the farm or demonstration-project owner
inputs: actual farm or demonstration project objectives
actual production constraints
outputs: chosen production targets, units and periods

steps.what: Obtain and verify actual production observations and explain missing or inconsistent measures
inputs: chosen production targets, units and periods
actual farm observations and existing production records

steps.what: Compare actual production with targets and prepare variance tables
inputs: verified actual production measures
chosen production targets, units and periods

steps.what: Interpret actual deviations and discuss feasible production adjustments
inputs: checked production variance table
actual farm constraints
outputs: actual interpreted deviations and chosen follow-up

steps.what: Write and check actual target-monitoring decisions and retain the internal record
inputs: actual interpreted deviations and chosen follow-up

tasks.design: Configure unit-aware target and variance tables in the existing {SPREADSHEET}. Retain target choice, actual measure collection/verification, interpretation and actual decision records; save only repeated table preparation, with no credit for existing calculation runtime.
tasks.previous_blocker: Targets and actuals may be compared using repeatedly assembled tables.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables can reuse period/unit formulas and layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, biological variation and missing observations complicate production interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The educator distinguishes an avoidable process problem from an unrealistic target.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated variance-table work; production advice stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native spreadsheet tables can reuse target comparisons while actual production observation and interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional educator-owned monitoring of a client farm or teaching/demonstration project, not an invented factory-management role. Five of20 comparison points are repeat table/formula setup; fifteen remain for alignment/checks. Existing formulas earn no new saving.

Farm/project owner and actual observations supply dated production quantity, unit, crop/product and period. Educator verifies/captures missing measures in s2; no sensor feed is invented. Target choice and new written decisions are separate and retained, including ordinary ungated internal save.
unknowns: Does this educator actually own production monitoring and which tables are already configured?
research_questions: Can tables preserve unit and growing-period distinctions across actual farm records?

incremental.description: Maintain production units, target periods and variance-table checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 repeated comparison-table points minus0.6 upkeep=4.4. Low: a new crop changes units and periods, leaving only2 existing layout points reusable, minus0.6=1.4. Target setting, observations, interpretation and decision records keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with care professionals on family home-management advice.

steps.what: Understand actual family needs and capture relevant home-management facts with permission
inputs: actual family request
actual family-provided budget, meal or time constraints
outputs: checked actual home-management facts and family priorities

steps.what: Prepare and check applicable household budget or time-allocation comparisons
inputs: checked actual home-management facts and family priorities

steps.what: Collaborate with social service and health care professionals and give tailored family advice
inputs: checked applicable household comparison
checked actual home-management facts and family priorities
actual professional advice and family responses
outputs: actual tailored home-management advice and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Write and check assigned personalised home-management advice and retain the internal case record
inputs: actual tailored home-management advice and agreed follow-up
outputs: checked saved personalised advice and actual case record

tasks.design: Configure native household comparison formulas in {SPREADSHEET}, using actual family-provided facts already checked by the educator. Keep needs discovery, care-professional collaboration, tailored advice and full personalised written casework in {DOCS}; ordinary internal saving has no approval gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Simple budget or time comparisons may be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can reuse arithmetic without deciding family priorities.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive circumstances and conflicting needs require trust and professional collaboration.
tasks.human_edge: The educator recognises when a numerically balanced plan is impractical for the family.
tasks.altitude: Less simple comparison preparation; family and care decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native arithmetic can assist household comparisons while personalised home-management advice remains human.

assumptions: Provisional budget/time-advice case: three of15 comparison points are repeated sum/category setup, with twelve checking/context points retained. For advice without such comparisons, remove branch and reweight rather than invent it. Existing formulas earn no new credit.

Family supplies actual dated income/expense amounts, currency and periods or actual time constraints; educator captures/checks these in s1. Missing facts require manual clarification. No medical inference, free transcript or transferred clinician labour. Advice is given live; actual assigned written casework is retained separately, with no invented extra send.
unknowns: Which comparisons and written records does this educator actually own?
research_questions: Do comparison templates retain irregular income and actual caring constraints?

incremental.description: Maintain comparison units/categories and permitted case access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 repeated arithmetic/setup points minus0.4 upkeep=2.6. Low: irregular household income needs mostly manual comparison, leaving only1 stable expense-total setup point removed, minus0.4=0.6. Family discovery, collaboration and complete personalised written advice stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist farmers with transactions, properties and physical sampling.

steps.what: Locate and verify current product or supply specifications, prices and trading contacts
inputs: actual farmer's purchase or sale request
actual counterparty product information and terms
outputs: verified applicable product/supply information and contact

steps.what: Prepare and check exact proposed purchase or sale, quantities, price, terms and destination
inputs: verified applicable product/supply information and contact
actual farmer's request and constraints
outputs: checked final proposed transaction and counterparty destination

steps.what: Review and authorise the exact final transaction and counterparty destination
inputs: checked final proposed transaction and counterparty destination
outputs: farmer-authorised final transaction version and destination

steps.what: Send the exact farmer-authorised purchase or sale instruction to the named counterparty
inputs: farmer-authorised final transaction version and destination
outputs: actual transaction instruction and counterparty receipt

steps.what: Perform actual property supervision and assess site conditions for the farmer
inputs: actual assigned property-supervision scope
actual property conditions
outputs: actual property observations and supervision actions

steps.what: Collect actual soil and herbage samples, labels and field observations for testing
inputs: actual farmer's sampling request and sampling method
actual soil and herbage at assigned sites
outputs: actual collected labelled samples and field observations

steps.what: Write and check assigned actual farm-assistance, transaction and sampling records
inputs: actual transaction instruction and counterparty receipt
actual property observations and supervision actions
actual collected labelled samples and field observations

tasks.design: Configure current product/specification links in {PARTNER_PORTAL}/{DOCS} for actual farmer requests. Retain transaction preparation, farmer authorisation, the explicit counterparty send, physical property/sampling work and complete assigned records; internal saves and the actual send earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated product-source navigation can precede farm assistance transactions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-source links can remove navigation while prices and terms are still verified.
tasks.still_hard: Farmer commitments, real property conditions and representative sampling need people.
tasks.human_edge: The educator rejects a convenient sample location that would misrepresent the field.
tasks.altitude: Less product-source navigation; direct assistance remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current product-source links can reduce locating specifications while farm transactions, physical supervision and sampling remain accountable human work.

assumptions: Provisional mixed portfolio of actual assigned assistance, not a claim every visit includes all branches. Farmer authorisation5 is customer labour excluded from focal baseline95. Drop unowned branches and reweight from actual cases; do not add these activities to an advice-only role.

Counterparties supply actual product id/specification, dated quote, unit, currency and terms; educator verifies these. Three of15 source points are repeated navigation; actual price/terms checks remain. Native existing links earn no credit.

Farmer supplies actual request and transaction authority; final proposed transaction exists before actual farmer review, and any edit invalidates it. Educator captures actual sample id, site, date, method and observed conditions during collection. No soil result is inferred and no new laboratory portal entry/report/send is assumed; map an actual owned laboratory handoff separately before assigning any saving.

Assigned written assistance records are separated from physical work and fully retained, including ordinary ungated internal saves. No new supplier, farmer or laboratory effort is transferred for free.
unknowns: Which direct-assistance branches and transaction route does the educator actually own?
research_questions: Can source links preserve quote dates and units without hiding changed terms?

incremental.description: Maintain current product-source and counterparty links.

approvals.approved_version: s2 exact final transaction quantities, price, terms and named counterparty reviewed by farmer in s3; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 repeated product-source navigation points:3/95*100 minus0.4=2.757. Low: a new supply requires fresh manual sourcing, leaving only0.5 existing contact-navigation points removed, giving0.5/95*100 minus0.4=0.126. Transaction choices, farmer review, actual send, property work, samples and written records retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce selected comparison setup and source navigation while retaining family and farm judgement.
role.ambitious_version: Reliable supporting comparisons and sources for educators who retain direct advice and fieldwork.
